strict_probe_failure_classification: Probe infrastructure boundary: two real dependencies read public /proc/version for Linux/WSL detection. The strict guard blocked both without reading content. A later TEMP probe allowed only that one OS metadata file and supplied declared mock host resourcesPath; then actual main require returned with zero forbidden effects. No application source or permissions/policy was altered.

runtime_scope_limit: Actual Node24 loaded the entire built main.cjs and its real external JS dependencies under an explicitly mocked Electron host. app.whenReady remained unresolved; no real windows, provider requests, native bootstrap, server listening, installed Electron or Mac acceptance was exercised. Independently, the actual bundled SQLite module ran real database controls on Node24.
